input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parser splits the file into lines with `text.split("\n")` (src/ingest/parser.ts:72), which does not account for Windows-style `\r\n` line endings. Since finance's new export tool runs on Windows, each line (including the header) now ends with a trailing `\r`, which throws off the column count comparison used to validate rows, producing the "Malformed row" error starting at row 1. The line-splitting/column-parsing logic needs to normalize or strip `\r` characters before comparing row shapes.
